author: piratewithgun
body:
so today i play on throwback and the very first thing i notice is that there was a very disturbing amount of block lag and even LAG BACK! after inquiring into this i discovered that the anticheat has been brought back! There have already been a lot of players complaining about this ingame and i am personally very sad about this change. (bear in mind that throwback is the only nebula server i play on because up until now it has been relatively lag free) 

i think we have enough mods to be able to afford not to have the anti cheat because the side effects of it really ruin the gameplay

please share your opinions!
